author: Jinkai Liu

gloss.en: A monastery or convent governed by an abbot or abbess; also its buildings or church
gloss.zh-Hans: 由男修道院院长或女修道院院长主持的修道院，也可指其建筑或教堂

meaning.en: The primary Chinese lexical equivalent is 修道院. 比, 笔 and 蓓 are not standard translations.
meaning.zh-Hans: 主要汉语词义对应是“修道院”；“比”“笔”“蓓”都不是标准翻译。

rationale.en: Authoritative English and French dictionaries define the word as a monastic institution. The Chinese target records that ordinary lexical meaning; sound and literary candidates remain separate observations.
rationale.zh-Hans: 权威英语、法语词典均把该词定义为修道制度中的机构。汉语目标记录普通词义对应；声音候选与文学候选另轨保存。

title.en: ABBEY · Monastery · A Diachronic Root Path
title.zh-Hans: ABBEY · 修道院 · 历时词根路径

gloss.en: A monastery or convent governed by an abbot or abbess; also its buildings or church

meaning.en: Standard Translation: abbey → 修道院 / 修院 · Supported. Root Mapping Candidate: ABBA ↔ 爸 bà (FATHER). Kinship control: early-child speech resemblance; historical Aramaic–Chinese relation Not claimed.
meaning.zh-Hans: 标准翻译：abbey → 修道院／修院 · Supported。词根候选：ABBA ↔ 爸 bà（父亲）。亲属称谓控制：早期儿童发音相似；阿拉姆语与汉语历史关系 Not claimed。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Standard Translation · Supported; root candidate separately graded

rationale.en: The institution meaning and the FATHER root candidate are independently classified. Meaning first, consonant second. The abbey translation does not change to 爸.
rationale.zh-Hans: 机构词义与 FATHER 词根候选分别分级。Meaning first, consonant second.｜先定语义，再验辅音。abbey 的译词不改为爸。

original_author_hypothesis: 这个词应该从犹太教的阿比而来

independent_correction.en: The family ultimately traces to Aramaic abba via Greek and Latin, with French and English branches. Abbey is an English institution word, not a Jewish-language name or a Jewish title for a pastor.
independent_correction.zh-Hans: 该词族最终经希腊语和拉丁语追溯至阿拉姆语 abba，形成法语和英语分支。abbey 是英语机构词，不是“犹太语 abbey”或“犹太人称牧师 abbey”。

recalibration.principle: Meaning first, consonant second.｜先定语义，再验辅音。
recalibration.historical_path: English abbey ← Anglo-French / Old French abbeie / abaïe (also abeie / abbaye) ← Late / Medieval ecclesiastical Latin abbatia ← Latin abbas ← Greek abbas ← Aramaic abba “father / my father”
recalibration.semantic_path: ABBA (FATHER) → ABBAS / ABBOT / ABBÉ (SPIRITUAL FATHER / MONASTIC SUPERIOR) → ABBATIA / ABBAYE / ABBEY (office/institution → monastery)

path_boundary.en: This is a family/semantic summary, not a linear borrowing chain through every slash-separated form. French abbé and English abbot are parallel descendants of the title family. CNRTL distinguishes abbatia as abbatial office/dignity and as monastery. Merriam-Webster labels abbatia Medieval Latin; Etymonline calls it Late Latin. Father is the shared dictionary gloss; my father is Etymonline’s gloss, not a claim that every occurrence has possessive morphology.
path_boundary.zh-Hans: 这是词族／语义概括，不是所有斜线词形之间依次借入。法语 abbé 与英语 abbot 是称谓词族的分支。CNRTL 区分 abbatia 的院长职务／尊位义与修道院义。Merriam-Webster 标中世纪拉丁语，Etymonline 标晚期拉丁语。father 是共同释义；my father 按 Etymonline 归属，不断言每一用例都具有所有格形态。

Only then check proposed consonant group

semantic_selection.en: Select 爸 for FATHER before inspecting sound; retain 父 / 爹 / 爷 as semantic alternatives even outside the proposed group.
semantic_selection.zh-Hans: 先按 FATHER 选择爸，再检查声音；父／爹／爷作为语义备选保留，不因不符合辅音组而排除。

consonant_comparison.label: b ↔ b / b-p-m-f candidate group
consonant_comparison.source: b in transliterated abba; historical pronunciation requires period-specific evidence
consonant_comparison.target: Pinyin b in bà represents unaspirated /p/
consonant_comparison.boundary: Comparison labels are not identical IPA values. Gemination, vowels, syllable structure and tone require independent evaluation; no sound law established.

scores.consonant_group_fit: Within proposed group at label level

control.en: Kinship control: recurrent early-child / baby-talk articulatory patterns are an alternative explanation for similar father/mother terms across languages. ABBA ↔ 爸 is a root-level Phonetic-Semantic Candidate, not abbey’s translation and not evidence of Aramaic–Chinese cognacy. Historical Relation: Not claimed. This control is not a demonstrated origin story for this particular pair.
control.zh-Hans: 亲属称谓控制：跨语言父母称谓常出现相似的早期儿童／婴儿语发音模式，构成替代解释。ABBA ↔ 爸是词根级音义候选，不是 abbey 的标准翻译，也不是阿拉姆语与汉语历史同源的证据。Historical Relation: Not claimed。控制因素不等于已证明此词对的具体起源。

kinship_research_note.status: Scoped dictionary evidence; historical dating and reconstructions in Research Queue

note.en: 父 / 爸 / 爹 / 爷 have different roles by period, dialect and register. 爸 has historical dictionary witnesses; do not infer a recent foreign borrowing or a first attestation from the modern form. 爹 includes father and other address senses; 爷 includes father, grandfather and honorific senses, not one universal replacement timeline. Modern dialects are not frozen copies of ancient Chinese.
note.zh-Hans: 父／爸／爹／爷在时期、方言与语体中的角色不同。爸有历史字书见证；不能据现代形式断言近代外来或首见年代。爹有父亲及其他称呼义；爷有父亲、祖父、尊称等义，不能概括成全国统一的替代时间线。现代方言不是古汉语冻结复制品。

future_experiment.design: Preregister semantic selection independently of sound; blinded sound ratings; retain 父/爹/爷 regardless of group fit; compare kinship and non-kinship baselines, unrelated /ba,pa,ma/ items and shuffled meaning controls; count abbey/abbaye/abbé/abbot/abbess as one historical family; do not constrain Chinese-internal semantic paths.
